description: Convert a video clip to an animated GIF, with the frames, size and speed you choose. Can you run shell commands? Then do not send base64: upload the file from disk with curl -F file=@<path> https://helpyself.com/api/v1/tools/video-to-gif (same tool, same answer, much faster). A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

data.description: The video file, base64-encoded; a data: URL prefix is stripped if present. MP4 is what the transformer expects. Roughly 26 MB of video at most. Send the whole file as it is, up to 25 MB: do not crop, shrink or split it first. If you can run shell commands, do not write the base64 out yourself: send the file from disk with curl -F file=@<path> -F <option>=<value> https://helpyself.com/api/v1/tools/video-to-gif (add -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" if you have one); the answer is the same JSON.

fps.description: Frames per second of the GIF. fps times seconds is the frame count, capped at 300. Above about 15 the file grows faster than it improves. Defaults to 10.

seconds.description: How many seconds of the clip to use, counted from the start. The rest is discarded. Defaults to 3.

width.description: Longest edge of the output in pixels, up to 1280; the other edge follows the clip's aspect ratio. Defaults to 480.

name: video_to_gif
title: Video to GIF
